heading: Confidentiality policy
collected_heading: Which information is going to be collected
collected_registration: For registration we keep a username (or nickname) and an email address. Signing in with Google, GitHub, Yandex or another provider that may be added later confirms your email address; an account created with the sign-up form confirms it with a one-time code sent to that address.
collected_logs: Our web server has automatic settings for keeping some general logs which are mainly going to be used for further investigation of web server problems (if any). Some logs can include IP address, type of browser, time of request, etc.
usage_heading: How the getting information is going to be used
usage_text: The combination of username (or nickname) and email address is used for generation of a random anonymous user ID. This User ID is used for linking all artifacts (topology information, graphs ID, plots ID, device groups, etc) to the actual user. It is worth to mention, that unregistered users do not have such options (saving multiple graphs, groups, etc) because of lack of technical ability to link such unregistered user to multiple artifacts.
watcher_text: A watcher you install sends to Topolograph the topology of the network it listens to (router IDs, device hostnames, interface addresses, link costs and TE attributes), BGP routes (prefixes, AS paths, communities and route targets), VRF names and route distinguishers, RSVP LSP data, the changes it detects, and a heartbeat with the watcher host address. This data is stored in your account and shown only to you and to the users you share a graph with. It describes network devices; if your device names identify people, avoid such names in the network you monitor. Data received from watchers on topolograph.com is deleted automatically 14 days after it was received. You can delete the graphs and events of a watcher at any time; deleting the watcher stops collection.
trial_text: Earlier Topolograph kept a keyed one-way hash (HMAC) of the email address and of the router IDs of each network a watcher reported. No new hashes are made. The existing ones are stored without an account ID, only Topolograph, which holds the key, can compare them with an address or router IDs, and they are deleted automatically 12 months after they were made.
third_parties_text: Personal data of users can be transferred to persons not associated with this site, if necessary:
third_parties_law: to comply with the law, regulatory act, the execution of a court decision;
third_parties_malfunctions: to eliminate technical malfunctions of the site;
third_parties_requests: to provide information on the basis of a request from authorized state bodies.
security_text: The site administration takes measures to protect user data from unauthorized access, in particular:
security_server: use to host a virtual dedicated server site.
rights_text: You can ask for a copy of your data, its correction, or the deletion of your account at admin@topolograph.com. On such a request we delete the account together with its graphs, events and watchers. The stored hashes carry no account ID, so they are deleted when they expire.
changes_text: Privacy policy updates are published on this page.
